subject: Next steps & evidence plan — Meridian Health pilot
messages:
From: Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@meridianhealth.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Gallagher <tom.gallagher@meridianhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro / pilot scope — quick follow-up

Evelyn — thanks again for the demo earlier. Quick recap from our side and a couple of asks so we can move the security/contract reviews forward: 

- Meridian is aligned on a 6-week PoC focused on outpatient notes generation (sanitized data).
- Procurement will need a short evidence bundle (SOC 2 status, recent pen test summary, data retention policy, and audit log export examples).
- Our security lead wants to confirm that host-level logs and API access logs can be exported for a specified timeframe.

Can you send an initial evidence list and an estimated delivery timeline by end of week? Also please include the expected owner on your side for each evidence item so we can route internally.

Thanks,
Samantha
Samantha Ortiz
Director, Digital Transformation
Meridian Health
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@meridianhealth.com>, Tom Gallagher <tom.gallagher@meridianhealth.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 19 Jul 2028 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps & evidence plan — Meridian Health pilot

Samantha / Tom — great meeting, thanks for the clarity. Below is our plan and owners for each request; I’ll follow up with a calendar invite to sync procurement + security next week.

Evidence items / owner / ETA:
- SOC 2 status & scope (Aditya) — initial package (summary + link to cert) by Mon 7/22
- Pen test summary / remediation status (Neha) — pen test executive summary by Wed 7/24, full report available under NDA
- Data retention & deletion policy (Evelyn) — policy excerpt + example retention settings by Mon 7/22
- Audit log samples & export mechanics (Neha) — sample export (CSV) + doc describing fields by Thu 7/25
- PoC SOW (commercial + timeline) — draft attached (PoC_SOW_Meridian_draft.pdf); Evelyn to incorporate any procurement-specific clauses

A couple of clarifying Qs for your security lead so we can size the log export work: 
1) What retention window do you want examples for (30/90/365 days)?
2) Do you need redacted payloads or full request/response records?

I’ll mark owners on the internal tracker and share the spreadsheet with your procurement contact (Meridian_SOC2_Questions_v2.xlsx).

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Lead Solutions Engineer, Sales
Redwood Inference
From: Tom Gallagher <tom.gallagher@meridianhealth.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@meridianhealth.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@meridianhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Jul 2028 08:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps & evidence plan — Meridian Health pilot

Thanks Evelyn — procurement looped in. Procurement asks that the SOC 2 scope include SaaS hosting and data processing (if not already explicit). Also confirming: 90-day retention sample would be most helpful to show exports and turnover.

Procurement contact: Michelle Park (procurement@meridianhealth.com) — Michelle, Evelyn will share the initial bundle and the draft SOW; can you confirm any mandatory PO language or insurance thresholds we should include now to avoid rework?

Tom
VP, Product Ops
Meridian Health
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Jul 2028 09:11:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Internal: Meridian evidence owner + timeline

Team — tagging internal owners and constraints for the Meridian ask. I’ll own the SOC 2 package and the quick summary for procurement. Notes below: 

- SOC 2: we have an up-to-date Type II cert covering our hosted API and processing layers (scope: inference API + model storage). I’ll prepare a one-page cover + cert link and redact internal IDs. ETA EOD Mon 7/22.
- Pen test: exec summary available; full report requires NDA; recent test (May 2028) found two low/medium findings; remediation completed for both. Neha, can you confirm export format for the audit log sample?
- Audit logs: We can provide a 90-day sample exported as CSV with request_id, timestamp, route, response_code, token_count, and user_provided_id (we can redact PII). Generating a sample will take ~2 business days if we include a short how-to.
- Data retention: our standard retention policy is 90 days for request payloads, 365 for aggregated telemetry, retention/deletion controls can be configured per-customer on Redwood Private / Dedicated. I have a one-page excerpt ready.

Attachments to send to Meridian from our side: Meridian_SOC2_Questions_v2.xlsx (questions + mapping), PoC_SOW_Meridian_draft.pdf (Evelyn will finalize).

AD
Aditya Rao
Head of Trust & Security, Redwood Inference
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@meridianhealth.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 24 Jul 2028 10:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Meridian — audit log sample and pen test summary

Samantha / team — attaching the pen test executive summary and a redacted 90-day audit log sample (CSV stub). A few implementation notes: 

- Pen test exec summary (attached) outlines two medium findings (XSS in admin console, outdated dependency in telemetry pipeline) both remediated and verified by our vendor. Full report available under NDA.
- Audit log CSV: we removed any direct PII fields and replaced user email with user_id hashes. Columns included: request_id, ts_utc, api_route, status_code, token_count, user_id_hash. If Meridian needs request/response payloads for a particular sample window we can provide redacted payloads under an NDA and a scoped export job.
- ETA: CSV sample + short README delivered now; full export with redacted payloads would take 3 business days with an approved NDA.

Attachments: Redwood_PenTest_ExecSummary_Jun2028.pdf (stub), Meridian_audit_log_sample_90d.csv (stub)

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Security Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@meridianhealth.com>, Tom Gallagher <tom.gallagher@meridianhealth.com>, Procurement <procurement@meridianhealth.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 25 Jul 2028 17:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Meridian — delivery plan and next steps

Samantha / Tom / Michelle — thanks, all materials are now staged. Quick delivery recap and asks: 

- Sent: Meridian_SOC2_Questions_v2.xlsx (questions + mapping) and PoC_SOW_Meridian_draft.pdf (Evelyn to update commercial section if procurement requests PO language).
- Sent: Pen test exec summary (Neha) and redacted 90-day audit log sample (Neha).
- SOC 2 summary & cert link (Aditya) — included in the spreadsheet.

Open items for Meridian approval: 
1) Please confirm 90-day sample is sufficient for your security review or if you require redacted payloads (we can provide under NDA, 3 business day turnaround).
2) Procurement: any mandatory PO language / insurance thresholds to include in SOW?

Proposed next steps: 
- If procurement confirms no special PO clauses, we’ll finalize SOW and target PoC start week of 8/7.
- If Meridian requests redacted payloads, Michelle — please send NDA contact or preferred template and we’ll fast-track.

I’ll follow up with a 30-minute Q&A with your security team early next week — propose Tue 7/30 or Wed 7/31. Let me know which works.

Best regards,
Evelyn Hart
Lead Solutions Engineer, Sales
Redwood Inference
